blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. The BSC USDu token 0xea953ea6634d55dac6697c436b1e81a679db5882 is source-matched, fixed ERC20Permit + ERC20Burnable + Ownable2Step; burnFrom consumes holder allowance and the owner can replace the minter but cannot pause transfers, upgrade, blacklist, seize, or grant an arbitrary-holder burner. At BSC block128507506, owner=0x8e3811b4dc5022ab9c8afbb54be4aa23780c62b3 and EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots are zero. Source: https://sourcify.dev/server/v2/contract/56/0xea953ea6634d55dac6697c436b1e81a679db5882?fields=sources,abi . The Solana mint 9ckR7pPPvyPadACDTzLwK2ZAEeUJ3qGSnzPs8bVaHrSy at finalized account context slot458736124 has freezeAuthority=null, self mint authority and only metadata extensions. Both are material: Accountable's checkpoint supply split is BSC41464484.46 and Solana11453464.93, approximately78.36%/21.64%. No declared parent is identified. The issuer says only whitelisted addresses can mint or redeem (https://docs.unitas.so/solution-design/minting-usdu.md); terms dated27August2026 say contracts operate permissionlessly and deny wallet freeze/burn/seizure (https://docs.unitas.so/resources/terms-of-service.md). Do not conflate entry-only restrictions with redemption restrictions, or infer a live holder-facing exit gate from conflicting prose: current controller code and revocation authority remain unverified. Accountable source checkpoint2026-10-17T22:38:54.317Z reports $58690851.38 reserves: Bitcoin55.33701%, Solana20.98673%, Binance19.20778%, Bnb_smartchain4.46848%. The documented Ceffu/Binance custody rail supplies a categorical19.20778% qualifying lower bound; the defensible overall bound is19.20778%-100%, not observed zero. Exact Bitcoin representation/custody and Solana/JLP constituent weights are missing. HT Digital's16October2026 09:00:08UTC letter separately lists BTC35.290m, JLP12.513m, USD1 3.862m, BSC-USD1.926m, U1.153m, USDT0.450m and Other assets0.435m ($55.629m total). It does not map those assets to the17October venue buckets or identify the custody share of BTC, and explicitly says CEX balances include unrealized margin PnL and assurance is a future engagement. The two checkpoints cannot be combined into a normalized exposure figure. Strict provisional No remains low-confidence and unresolved pending reserve mapping and the live redemption-gate check.

oracleRisk.summary: ORCHESTRATOR-AUTHORIZED adverse-pin correction — owner review required. The original oracleless rationale established only that USDu has no borrower CDP liquidation engine; it did not establish absence of a price-sensitive mint/redemption authority. Rechecked 2026-10-20: the active BSC UnitasMintingV2 uses off-chain orders carrying collateral_amount and usdu_amount, accepted by a privileged MINTER_ROLE or REDEEMER_ROLE executor after benefactor/delegated/EIP-1271 authorization. Its stable-asset guard compares nominal decimal-normalized amounts against admin-set stablesDeltaLimit, without an independent market-price feed; non-stable order amounts have no such price comparison. The operator therefore controls execution of economically effective quotes. BSC block 128826770/hash 0xbbf56fed79c35af279a5a79ebfa2ad934ac1eebaccc338fa133147438e31081f (2026-10-20T22:33:29Z) binds USDu.minter() to 0xbb984ce670100aa855f6152f88b26ee57f4ea82a and minter.usdu() back to the token; runtime text SHA-256 684d35568e31c5c6cd4c1574ca46a86ad2bb09d0e43fd7487e96764455849fc9 matches the historical verified-source pin. This corrects the known native BSC pricing path, not the unresolved Solana program's authority or a claim of a pricing incident. Original review starts and prior sources are retained.

branchApplicability.rationale: Unitas's protocol-managed delta-neutral portfolio uses collateral and hedge marks to monitor margin, PnL, exposure, and liquidity, with bots rebalancing hedge sizes about hourly to keep net exposure aligned. Those internal market-value inputs affect the top-level redemption and reserve operation; USDu has no borrower-specific debt or liquidation branches, so the disposition is top-level-only.
